comment_create.description: User creates a new comment on an object. MCP-originated writes include metadata.source=mcp.

comment_edit.description: User edits their own comment. MCP-originated writes include metadata.source=mcp.

comment_delete.trigger: DELETE /api/community/comments/[id], DELETE /api/community/comments/batch, GraphQL commentDelete/commentsDelete, MCP community_comment_delete, or registered GraphQL operations
comment_delete.description: User deletes their own comment. Transport-originated writes include safe metadata.source where available.

comment_react.trigger: POST /api/community/comments/[id]/reactions, DELETE /api/community/comments/[id]/reactions, MCP community_comment_reaction_add, or MCP community_comment_reaction_remove
comment_react.description: User adds or removes a reaction on an active visible comment. MCP-originated writes include metadata.source=mcp.

description_edit.description: User updates an object description (content changed). The description row, edit history, and audit row are committed together.

upload_delete.trigger: DELETE /api/workspace/uploads/[id], GraphQL uploadDelete, MCP workspace_upload_delete, or the registered GraphQL operation
upload_delete.description: User deletes an upload they own. Transport-originated writes include metadata.source where available. After storage deletion succeeds, metadata deletion and the audit row are committed together.

section_retire.description: The importer marks one missing in-scope Section inactive without deleting the row or children. The same transaction records the Section target, source snapshot SHA-256, observation time, and jwId.

section_reactivate.description: The importer clears retiredAt when a Section reappears. The same transaction records the Section target, source snapshot SHA-256, observation time, jwId, and previous retiredAt.

admin_user_suspend.description: Admin suspends a user account. The suspension change and audit row are committed together.

admin_user_unsuspend.description: Admin lifts a user suspension. The suspension change and audit row are committed together.

admin_comment_moderate.description: Admin hides or moderates a comment. The moderation change and audit row are committed together.

admin_description_moderate.description: Admin updates description content from the moderation workflow. The description row, edit history, and audit row are committed together.

webhook_login.description: Internal debug login aid (not a product surface). When enabled in a private environment, audit metadata records the lookup mode only; secrets and session tokens are never stored.

account_create.trigger: POST /api/auth/sign-up or another Better Auth user-provisioning endpoint
account_create.description: Records successful account provisioning after the user transaction commits. Credentials, tokens, and request bodies are excluded.

account_sign_in.description: Records successful sign-in after the session transaction commits without copying the session token.

account_sign_out.description: Records successful sign-out after the session transaction commits.

account_profile_update.description: Records successful profile changes with an allowlisted changed-field list, never field values or request bodies.

account_credential_update.description: Records successful credential changes with changed-field names only; password and token values are excluded.

account_link.trigger: POST /api/auth/link-social or another Better Auth authenticated account-link endpoint
account_link.description: Records successful linking for the authenticated user after commit, excluding provider credentials and tokens.

account_unlink.description: Records successful provider unlinking after commit, excluding provider credentials and tokens.

account_delete.description: Records denial or failure while the user exists. The success row deliberately omits the deleted user's raw identifier.

account_passkey_create.description: Records committed passkey registration from the final endpoint result, excluding attestation, credential material, and request bodies.

account_passkey_update.description: Records committed passkey updates using only the passkey identifier and safe request context.

account_passkey_delete.description: Records committed passkey deletion using only the passkey identifier and safe request context.

account_session_revoke.description: Records successful current-user session revocation after commit without copying session tokens.

account_calendar_token_create.description: Records successful token creation without storing the calendar feed token value.

account_calendar_token_rotate.description: Records denied, failed, and successful rotation without storing old or new token values.

oauth_authorization_grant.description: Records a grant atomically with authorization state and verification-code creation, excluding codes, tokens, state, and request bodies.

oauth_authorization_update.description: Records an authorization scope change atomically with authorization state using scope counts and changed-field names only.

oauth_authorization_revoke.description: Records revocation atomically with authorization deletion using safe identifiers and counts only.

writer: writeAuditLog records transactional app trails. Better Auth database after hooks run after commit and contain fireAuditLog failures so committed auth mutations cannot become false API failures. The static loader writes Section lifecycle rows within its import transaction.
